comments.author: Cjoubert
comments.body_html:
I looked at it this morning and found an Freelook fix in FOVFix, after disabling it in the .dll by not having it load in Awake(), it worked, if someone has the same problem and wonder how to fix, (always save up your data first before editing):

  • i use dnSpy to open the DLL and then go to FOVFix > FreeLookPatch > Plugin > Awake() rightclick > Edit Method Body

  • Remove the instance void FOVFix.FreelookPatch and the one below that has …..ModulePatch::enable()

  • Also to make it more immersive, i changed your plugin turn radius to -140,110, while holding a rifle, i am able to turn my upper body more to the left then to the right, which allow me to keep my gun on point while able to almost look behind me, deleted the previous message since i made a mistake and couldnt edit the message, to avoid sharing wrong info
